**[A genome-wide map of the genetic network in monocytes that regulates type I interferon induction by the cGAS-STING pathway.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42611972/)** *(from functional genomics/CRISPR screening)*  
*Thomsen Emil Aagaard; Zhao Jian; Narita Ryo; Davis Luther J; Olagnier David* — Science signaling 2026  
Score: **7/10** | Pathways: `cGAS-STING, treatment-target, NF-kB-IKK`

**[Type I Interferonopathies in the Differential Diagnosis of Vasculitis: A Comprehensive Review.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42611810/)** *(from Rheumatology/vasculitis)*  
*Gürbüz Nida; Ismayilova Shams; Ahmadova Gulnar; Çiftçi Rena; Aksu Güzide* — Journal of visualized experiments : JoVE 2026  
Score: **7/10** | Pathways: `cGAS-STING, JAK-STAT, AGS-spectrum, treatment-target, clinical-phenotype`
